02

Fixed Income

Every issuer reviewed before it reaches you.

  • Selected fixed income opportunities.

    We shortlist listed and unlisted bonds from companies with strong credit ratings.

  • A closer look at credit quality.

    We assess each company’s business, balance sheet and cash flows before recommending a bond.

  • Quotes on request, matched to you.

    Tell us your preferred yield, investment tenure and risk level. We’ll match suitable bonds and provide quotes on request.

  • Ongoing monitoring after you invest.

    We review each company every quarter for as long as you hold its bonds.

03

Debt Syndication

Debt structured around your business.

Helping companies of every size raise debt. We build the credit case for your business and manage the process from the first lender conversation through to disbursement.

What we arrange

  • Structured debt.

    Promoter funding and structures backed by the company’s cash flows.

  • Special situations.

    Funding when a business is under stress or working against a deadline.

  • Refinancing debt.

    Replacing debt that no longer suits the business, with repayments planned around its cash flows.

  • Mezzanine capital.

    Funding that ranks behind senior lenders and ahead of equity.

  • Primary debt raises.

    New debt raised through listed and unlisted NCDs (non-convertible debentures).

  • Term loans and working capital.

    Loans for capex or acquisitions, plus lines that fund day-to-day operations.

In brief

We expect September 2026 CPI inflation at 5.7%, above the 5.4% implied by the RBI’s path. Food does most of the work, with CPI food at 8.1% while core ex-jewellery holds at 3.0–3.2%.
